case.title: The Research Facility Mystery
case.introduction: Tonight at The Helix Research Institute, the theft of a very costly diamond called the Midnight Star has turned the evening upside down. No one is allowed to leave. 6 guests are still here, and each one is hiding something. One of them is not who they say they are. Find that person.
case.crime: The theft of a very costly diamond called the midnight star
case.target_fake_identity: Emma Castellano, a doctor people trust
case.escape_plan: Emma Castellano plans to sneak out while everyone is confused, and be gone before the police arrive.

timeline.description: The crime happens: the theft of a very costly diamond called the Midnight Star.
The alarm goes off. No one may leave.
Emma Castellano is seen moving toward a side door.

evidence.name: a wine glass
evidence.description: A half-full glass. The drink smells bitter.

evidence.name: a cheap phone
evidence.description: A cheap phone with only one number called.

evidence.name: muddy shoes
evidence.description: Costly shoes covered in garden mud, but it has not rained inside.

evidence.name: a photo
evidence.description: A photo of two guests who say they have never met.

evidence.name: a hidden key
evidence.description: A small brass key taped under a drawer.

evidence.name: a page from an account book
evidence.description: A page of numbers that do not add up.

evidence.name: a cloth with blood on it
evidence.description: A fine cloth with two letters sewn on it and a dark stain.

hidden_clues: Emma Castellano's story about where they were does not match the a wine glass.
Two guests say they have never met, but a photo shows they have.

solution.target_true_identity: A wanted criminal pretending to be a doctor
solution.reasoning: Emma Castellano is the hidden person. The main clues (a wine glass, a cheap phone) put them at the scene and show their story is not true. Their papers are fake too.

state.current_objective: 6 guests. One fake identity. It happened at The Helix Research Institute. Search the rooms, talk to everyone, and find the person behind the theft of a very costly diamond called the midnight star. Some guests lie. Check their stories carefully.
